body: T25 - NEW MCM COMPONENT WITH ANNOTATION. COMPONENT: Question Progress Indicator (sticky during exam). PROBLEM: On a 15-question exam Kai has no persistent position indicator. He must scroll to the top to see how many questions remain. Mid-exam, attention drifts partly because he does not know how far he is from the end. DESIGN: sticky bar at top of questionsContainer. Height 40px. Background: rgba(13,17,23,0.95) with backdrop-filter blur 8px. Content: left side - question counter (5 of 15). Right side - mini progress bar. COUNTER: font-size 13px, color rgba(255,255,255,0.7), bold number. Format: 5 of 15. MINI PROGRESS BAR: width 80px, height 4px, border-radius 2px. Track: rgba(255,255,255,0.1). Fill: Pistons blue #1D42BA advancing left to right. Fill calculated as answered-count divided by total. Answered = questions with any input entered. ANNOTATIONS: (1) backdrop-filter provides depth without hard border on dark bg. (2) 40px height is minimum for comfortable sticky bar - not crowding question cards. (3) Pistons blue fill matches brand without using error color. (4) 4px bar height: visible but not distracting. (5) Answered count not submitted count - Kai gets progress feedback before final submit. REDUCED MOTION: no animation, fill updates instantly on input. WCAG: counter text rgba(255,255,255,0.7) on rgba(13,17,23,0.95) = approximately 10:1. PASS.
